phases.title: Identity session and application runtime policy
VocoStar voice and media custom jobs

workItems.title: Replace persisted VocoStar tokens with the common Identity session
acceptance: Anonymous, email, Google and Apple sessions survive restart through secure native storage
No access or refresh token is declared in persistent FlutterFlow App State
Logout invalidates the server session and clears Purchases plus every transient FlutterFlow bridge
Account deletion enters the durable multi-module erasure workflow before local credentials are cleared
The legacy auth Logout endpoint and direct /clean/user call are absent

workItems.title: Replace application maintenance and update checks with App runtime policy
acceptance: Minimum and recommended versions are loaded before protected navigation
Maintenance and update URLs come from the selected SuperBoard target

workItems.title: Move uploads, downloads and deletion to the common Files authority
acceptance: Upload, download, list and delete use only the target Files origin
Configured MIME and byte limits are enforced before object persistence
Custom jobs reference only owner-scoped uploaded file identifiers

workItems.title: Register push devices through the common authenticated notification contract
acceptance: APNs and FCM device registration is project and user scoped
The device token remains transient and the legacy registration action is absent
A real notification is delivered, displayed and marked read on device

workItems.title: Remove direct RevenueCat and client entitlement authority
acceptance: Apple and Google sandbox purchases are durably verified before Store completion
Restore and entitlement state come from signed server CustomerInfo
Job credit consumption is atomic on the server

workItems.title: Load and measure the VocoStar onboarding through the common engine
acceptance: Screens 00 through 05 resolve from one versioned onboarding definition
Every legacy entry navigation targets the reusable SuperBoard onboarding page and the six copied pages are absent
Progression and completion events are visible in the back office
The final paywall resolves through Paywalls and Billing

workItems.title: Use the authenticated common marketing preference and consent contract
legacy: application-local consent and notification preference state
acceptance: Consent and suppression are project and user scoped
Newsletter opt-in, opt-out and transactional mail remain independently observable

workItems.title: Route VocoStar voice and media processing through authenticated custom jobs
acceptance: vocostar.voice.clone and vocostar.media.convert are capability allowlisted
Project and owner identity are derived server-side
Create, list, detail, owner-scoped cancellation, idempotency and progress are proven in the application
Failed-job retry is restricted to authenticated Grow back-office administrators

workItems.title: Replace the complete legacy Chatwoot client group with SuperBoard Support
legacy: persistent Chatwoot contact, conversation and pubsub state
acceptance: Contacts, conversations, messages and attachments reconcile with the exported source
Realtime reconnect, unread state, typing and CSAT work without a Chatwoot token
Rollback and retention are proven before the legacy source is retired

workItems.title: Clear FlutterFlow validation errors and run native acceptance
acceptance: FlutterFlow validation errors are zero and remaining SDK warnings are reviewed
CameraRecord and AudioRecord compile on iOS and Android
The complete production acceptance matrix passes on physical or hosted devices
